summary: End-to-end test of BotNira Stripe billing Phase 1 (plans, checkout, trial paywall, balance enforcement, exempt bypass, admin billing dashboard, landing pricing, vendor/admin UIs). 21/22 backend tests passed; all critical frontend flows verified. Two bugs found (1 backend, 1 frontend) — both line up against explicit review-request items.

critical.issue: Returns 400 'Invalid channel' instead of 402 'locked during trial' for a trial vendor (demo). server.py:892 whitelist is {whatsapp, email, sms} and does NOT include 'voice', so the paywall/trial gate is never reached. The review request explicitly requires: 'POST /api/simulate/voice as demo vendor returns 402'. Fix: add 'voice' to the whitelist set and let _vendor_can_use_channel do the 402 rejection (trial vendor has voice locked).

ui_bugs.issue: 'Voice Calls' tile is missing from the landing marketing channels strip. CHANNELS array contains only WhatsApp / Email / SMS & Chat. Review request explicitly calls for: 'Voice Calls tile present in channels strip' and 'restored Voice tile on landing marketing page'. Voice is referenced only in the Pricing card bullets, not as a standalone tile. Add { icon: Phone, label: 'Voice Calls', sub: '...' } to the CHANNELS array.

action_items: Add 'voice' to allowed simulate channels whitelist in server.py line 892 so that POST /api/simulate/voice returns 402 (trial-locked) instead of 400 (invalid channel). The downstream _vendor_can_use_channel() already rejects voice for trial vendors.

Restore the Voice Calls tile in Landing.jsx CHANNELS array so the landing page channels strip shows all 4 (Voice / WhatsApp / Email / SMS & Chat), matching the product copy which says 'phone, WhatsApp, email, SMS, web chat'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2004 lines — well past the 700-line threshold. Recommend splitting into modules: billing.py, simulate.py, admin.py, auth.py, conversations.py. Current monolith makes bug isolation painful (e.g., the simulate-voice bug would be obvious in a dedicated module).
The /api/simulate/{channel} handler duplicates whitelist logic that _vendor_can_use_channel() is already authoritative on. Delete the inner whitelist so channel policy lives in one place.
Webhook dev-mode bypass (empty STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET → accepts any JSON) is fine for local, but hard-fail (500) in prod if secret missing. Add a runtime guard.
payment_transactions collection: make sure _id is excluded on any future read endpoint (current /billing/checkout/status and /admin/billing/{id} already project _id:0 — good).

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all critical flows pass; only Voice tile missing on landing)

test_credentials: admin@botnira.com/admin123, demo@botnira.com/demo123, kamal@thedigisparrow.com/kamal123 — all present in /app/memory/test_credentials.md and confirmed working.
seed_data_creation: Reset demo vendor's messages_balance to 100 via MongoDB at session start, and reset/decrement-test at 3→2 and hard-stop at 0 → restored to 100 at end. Signup test created a TEST_bill_<uuid>@botnira.com vendor — left in DB (prefixed TEST_ for easy cleanup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_billing.py -v. The only failing test is TestTrialEnforcement::test_locked_channels_402[voice] (see action_items #1). Frontend Landing.jsx is missing Voice tile in CHANNELS array (action_items #2). All other flows — Stripe Checkout redirect, paywall 402, balance decrement, hard-stop at 0, kamal exempt bypass (balance never decrements, all channels unlocked), admin /admin/billing dashboard, signup trial defaults, webhook dev-mode — are passing. Stripe Checkout redirect was verified live (URL https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_...) without completing payment. Admin dashboard shows MRR/ARR/Active subs/Trialing/Total vendors cards and 6 vendor rows including kamal with infinity-balance badge.

simulate_voice_400.root_cause: server.py line 892 hardcodes channel whitelist to {'whatsapp','email','sms'}, preceding the paywall check. Voice is never forwarded to _vendor_can_use_channel, so trial vendor gets a 400 instead of the expected 402.
simulate_voice_400.repro: Login as demo@botnira.com → POST /api/simulate/voice with any message → returns 400 'Invalid channel'.
simulate_voice_400.fix: Change `if channel not in {'whatsapp','email','sms'}:` to `if channel not in {'whatsapp','email','sms','voice'}:`. _vendor_can_use_channel already returns (False, 'The voice channel is locked during trial. Upgrade to unlock.') for trial vendor, which raises HTTPException 402.

landing_missing_voice_tile.root_cause: Landing.jsx CHANNELS const (line 93) only defines 3 entries: WhatsApp, Email, SMS & Chat. Voice Calls tile was not added during the marketing page restore.
landing_missing_voice_tile.repro: Open / (landing page) → scroll to channels strip under 'One bot. Every channel.' → only 3 tiles rendered.
landing_missing_voice_tile.fix: Add `{ icon: Phone, label: 'Voice Calls', sub: 'Twilio-ready' }` (Phone already imported on line 2) as the first entry of CHANNELS. Update grid-cols if needed (currently md:border-r-2 based on index).
